Our C&I business is among the market leaders in the segment, and our portfolio has expanded by approximately 30% over the past year through contracts with marquee customers. Leverage also continues to trend downwards meaningfully, and we are already at approximately 5.5 levels for our operating portfolio, which is debt to EBITDA. Moving to page 11, I wanted to spend some time highlighting our key strengths. While everyone knows the size and scale of our portfolio, both in utility scale and C&I, over the years, we have developed in-house O&M and EPC capabilities.
